product.title: hidden beach tour

description.text: In Puerto Vallarta, this three-hour hidden beach tour leaves Punta de Mita for the Marietas water-tunnel swim when park access allows. The small boat is capped at eight travelers, with snorkeling gear, bottled water, lunch, and private transportation included. Guides handle the tunnel entry and in-water photos so the group can stay with Hidden Beach rather than assembling a self-guided boat. The meeting point is the Punta de Mita tourism cooperative in front of the small marina, and the return finishes at the same dock. The format suits visitors who want a compact island swim without a full-day Marietas cruise. Departures are confirmed at booking in Puerto Vallarta, and the itinerary stays on Punta de Mita and Hidden Beach rather than adding extra bay villages or resort stops.

highlights: Small-group Hidden Beach boat outing from Punta de Mita
Snorkel gear, bottled water, and lunch included
Swim through the water tunnel when park access allows
